Introduction
The institute was established in 1992. In light of the increasing importance of collaboration with clinical medicine, our headquarter and laboratory spaces are located at the second floor of the university hospital. Our faculty is currently comprised of 8 full-time staff and 9 adjunct teachers.
The research fields of our staff are quite diverse including signaling of cells, protein-protein interactions, modulation of protein synthesis, cytokine regulation and molecular mechanism of autoimmunity. In addition, we keep intimate research collaboration with medical doctors from our teaching hospital in genetic diseases, autoimmune diseases, infectious diseases…etc.
Our teaching program is also plentiful. Aside from the regular courses of Master and PhD programs, we offered the Master course since 1999 for the part-timers who are interested in the molecular biology. Under the supervision of Medical College, we began to offer an integrated course for 〝Genomic Medicine〞since 2000 for promoting the main stream education and research in 21th century in collaboration with Medical School, Institute of Clinical Medicine and Institute of Biological Chemistry and Molecular Biology. 〝Genetic Counseling〞is an another hot topic in the pre-clinical medicine. We have hosted the Master program for it in 2003 academic year in conjunction with Department of OBS/GYN and Department of Pediatrics, School of Medicine and Department of Nursing and Department of Medical Genetics, National Taiwan University Hospital for promoting the progression of genetic counseling domestically.
We expect the intramural cooperation will be more intimate with other academic disciplines including both basic and clinical scientists.

Application documents
Passport or ID
[Details]
Please provide a scanned copy of your passport; if you don't have a passport, please upload any national ID with your name on it such as ID card, driver's license, etc., that clearly indicates your full name and nationality.
Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) (if applicable)
[Details]
If you are a current or past holder of an ARC in Taiwan, please upload a copy here.
Graduation Certificate of highest degree awarded - Original version
[Details]
Please submit an official Graduation Certificate issued by the school/university. Students graduating in the current year shall submit a Certificate of Expected Graduation or a Certificate of Enrollment officially issued by the school/university.
Full Transcript of highest degree awarded (including records of each year and explanation of grading system) - Original version
[Details]
High school graduates must submit academic transcripts for grades 10 to 12. Graduates whose graduating year is academically equivalent to the second grade of a senior secondary school in Taiwan of a comparable academic level and nature, must submit transcripts for grades 7 to 11.
Graduation Certificate of highest degree awarded - Translated version
[Details]
Translated version is required if the original one is not in Chinese or English.
Full Transcript of highest degree awarded (including records of each year and explanation of grading system) - Translated version
[Details]
Translated version is required if the original one is not in Chinese or English.
Financial Statement
[Details]
All applicants shall provide a bank statement, issued by a bank within the past 3 months, showing a minimum balance equivalent to NTD 200,000 in savings deposit.
Scholarship recipients shall provide proof of scholarship. Applicants who have been granted scholarships or assistantships by NTU professors or departments/graduate institutes may submit relevant proof instead of a bank statement.
*If the bank account is not under the applicant's name, please submit the bank statement and the financial supporter's signed guarantee of financial support.
*If an applicant's bank account statement has insufficient funds, please submit the applicant's and financial supporter's bank statements with the total savings equivalent to NTD 200,000 within 3 months. Besides, the financial supporter shall also provide his or her signed guarantee of financial support.

Scholarship from college or department
Name : National Taiwan University College of Medicine Regulations Governing Scholarship for International Students
Amount : 1. Purpose: National Taiwan University College of Medicine (hereinafter referred to as NTUCM) has established this Scholarship within the international community to better support international student's academic success.
2. Number of Awardees: The actual number of awardees will base on the funds available, as well as number of qualified applications.
3. How to Apply:
(1) Eligibility: Graduate students applying for the scholarship must comply with the Ministry of Education’s Regulations for International Students Undertaking Studies in Taiwan.
(2) Application: Please apply to the University Office of International Affairs (OIA) at the same time when applying for admission.
4. Grant details:
(1) For master student: if the advisor or department admission office grant the monthly stipend at least TWD 4,000 to the application, NTUCM will match another TWD 4,000, so the application will qualify for the tuition waive from the OIA.
(2) For doctoral student: if the advisor or department admission office grant the monthly stipend at least TWD 7,500 to the application, NTUCM will match another TWD 7,500, so the application will qualify the tuition waive from the OIA.
(3) Duration of grant is two-year for master student, and three-year for doctoral student.
5. If the grant recipient is suspended, leaves the department, or the advisor decides to terminate the grant, the grant will be dismissed immediately.
6. Recipients of this Grant shall not receive any other scholarships or financial assistance sponsored by the University or the Taiwan government.
7. Matters not specified in these Regulations shall be governed by relevant regulations of the University or the Taiwan Ministry of Education.
8. These Regulations shall take effect upon public announcement after the approval of the College Administrative Committee.
Scholarship from NTU
Please refer to NTU Overseas Student Admissions >> Apply - Degree & Non-Degree Admissions >> Scholarships - Degree Admissions for detailed information.
*International student applicants who apply through the TIGP system are only eligible for TIGP scholarships, and are not able to receive the NTU scholarships.
